regionalPrompt: Read the complete regional-sales recipe in the live-dashboard skill. Create a new regional sales dashboard in the current Project using its bundled demo file and standard chart definition. Verify region filters, sales amounts and detail rows; do not substitute another example or unrelated existing project data. Execute real queries and two filter checks, then save a labeled demo draft without publishing.
salesPrompt: Read the complete sales-overview recipe in the live-dashboard skill. Create a new sales overview in the current Project using its bundled demo file and complete page. Include sales, orders, daily trends, region filters and details; do not substitute another example or unrelated existing project data. Execute real queries and two filter checks, then save a labeled demo draft without publishing.
qualityPrompt: Read the complete production-quality recipe in the live-dashboard skill. Create a new production quality dashboard in the current Project using its bundled demo file and complete page. Include produced, good, weighted yield, defective units and production-line filters; do not rename a sales dashboard or substitute sales data. Execute real queries and two line-filter checks, then save a labeled demo draft without publishing.
realDataPrompt: Create a dashboard using my real data. First inspect authorized sources in the current Project and confirm metric definitions. Do not substitute demo data.
superstoreDescription: Official retail teaching data: executive overview, product profitability, customers and returns. Requires a Data Xpert model.
superstorePrompt: Read themes/README.md and the complete superstore recipe (Trend Workspace for overview, Profit Atlas for profitability, Customer Brief for customers and returns) in the live-dashboard skill. Use the authorized published Data Xpert SuperstoreOrders model to create three separate dashboards in the current Project: executive overview, product profitability, and customers and returns. Preserve demo labels; validate all data and region, year and category filters, then save three drafts using the complete HTML and every Binding. Do not publish. If the model is unavailable, explain data preparation; never substitute other examples or invented rows.
